content: व्युत्थानम्, व्युत्थितिः {%f.%} .²1 Great activity. .²2 Rising up against, opposition, obstruction. .²3 Independent action, following oneʼs own bent of mind; व्युत्थानं च विकाङ्क्षाद्भिः कथाभिः प्रतिलोभ्यते <ls>Mb. 12. 111. 43</ls>. .²4 The completion of religious abstraction or abstract meditation (in Yoga <ab>phil.</ab>). .²5 A kind of dance. .²6 Causing (an elephant) to rise; यावच्चक्रे नाञ्जनं बोधनाय व्युत्थानज्ञो हस्तिचारी मदस्य <ls>Śi. 18. 26</ls>. .²7 Contradicting.
